purpose: Per-family fixture construction counts: W0 census-counter channel (attempt-1 instrumented runs) plus fresh counts taken on branch campaign/v1.00.28-w2.
method: W0 counter channel: the git-fixture helper emits one 'git:<shape> <timestamp-ms> <duration-ms> <strategy>' line per git-repository fixture construction; counts are line counts per suite log. Fresh counts: one run per suite on this branch, counting the same channel (campaign-repository: 0 lines) plus test counts from the suite summaries.

test-gsd-campaign-repository.source: fresh run on branch campaign/v1.00.28-w2 (0 'git:' counter lines; the suite builds planning trees, not git repositories)

count-per-suite.test-gsd-campaign-repository: 1 private root per test (33 tests, fresh run)

session-temp-directories.note: One private root per fixture instance plus one immutable pristine baseline directory per process for suites that consume the pristine fixture. Derived from the git-repository instance counts and the helper's per-process baseline rule.
session-temp-directories.source: derived from w0-counter-log counts + helper contract

git-branches-and-commits.note: Not instrumented by the W0 counter channel. Per-construction shape is fixed by the helper's baseline (default branch, single commit) and is covered by the safety suite's per-instance identity checks rather than by a counter.

worktrees.note: One per wave-worktree suite test instance ('git:w' family).

campaign-planning-trees.note: One planning tree per campaign-repository suite test; 33/33 tests green on the fresh run.

generated-fixtures.note: No independent generator family observed outside the repository and planning-tree families above.

subprocess-backed-verifier-environments.note: One per dv-base/dv-shape instance in the delivery-verifier suite; the verifier subprocess runs inside the fixture repository.

interpretation: Amplification is concentrated in the delivery-verifier suite (21 git repositories, 19 of them the same dv-base shape rebuilt per assertion group) and the wave-worktree suite (4 repositories + 4 worktrees). The W0 hypothesis that a pristine physical copy would be cheaper than 'git clone --no-local' is refuted by the checksummed experiment in git-fixture-experiment.json; see the truthful hold there.
